question: How much will Dune: Part Three gross domestically during its opening weekend?

calls.reasoning: Anchor: fan-driven event openings vs 3-week tracking; Dune 2 opened $82.5M, The Odyssey $124.5M (beat tracking). Current tracking: NRG $75-80M (Deadline says it will likely beat it), Boxoffice Pro $85-100M, Box Office Theory $91-115M. Presales reportedly WB's best ever and well ahead of The Odyssey early, plus an exclusive 3-week IMAX window with many 70mm sellouts. Downside: Avengers: Doomsday ($270M+ tracking) opens the same day and takes the non-IMAX premium screens, the pre-Christmas weekend dampens Sat/Sun, and front-loaded fan sales mean weaker walk-ups. Polymarket brackets (thin, ~$27k volume) imply a median ~$100-105M; treated as evidence, not an anchor. Median ~$100M.
calls.reference_class: Fan-driven event-film opening weekends vs 3-week-out tracking (Dune 1/2, The Odyssey, Oppenheimer-type IMAX tentpoles)

calls.reasoning: NRG tracking 3 weeks out is $75-80M (Nov 25); Boxoffice Pro $85-100M; bullish forum trackers $100M+ citing presales ahead of The Odyssey and a $25M+ presale total, plus an exclusive 3-week IMAX window. Reference class: premium-format event films beat tracking by ~20-40% (Dune 2 $65M+ -> $82.5M; Odyssey $80-100M -> $124.5M; Oppenheimer $40-50M -> $82M). Headwinds: head-to-head with Avengers: Doomsday ($270M+ tracking), pre-Christmas weekend, and the Odyssey presale comp is flawed. Polymarket brackets (thin, ~$27k volume; same terms: opening weekend, closes Dec 20) imply a median around $108M (<70 6%, 70-90 22%, 90-110 24%, 110-130 38-40%, 130+ 4%); treated as evidence, not an anchor. Median ~$99M.
sources: WebSearch: The Odyssey opening $124.5M / Deadline tracking $80-100M
calls.reference_class: Prestige/IMAX-heavy event films: NRG tracking ~3 weeks out vs actual domestic opening (Dune 1-2, Oppenheimer, The Odyssey)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: big presold IMAX tentpoles where actuals beat 3-week-out tracking by 20-30% (Dune 2, The Odyssey). NRG/Deadline has $75-80M; Box Office Theory has $91-115M; a presale tracker has $100M+ with ~$25M previews; presales run ahead of The Odyssey, which opened to $124.5M. Avengers: Doomsday on the same day ($270M+ tracking), the pre-Christmas date and a 150-min runtime cap the upside, while the IMAX exclusive supports it. Polymarket (thin, ~$27k, rules not verified) implies a median near $106M, consistent with mine. Median ~$103M.
